description: An unknown template result is not equal to a string with a different start
notes: The spec says a comparison with an unknown operand gives an unknown bool. hashicorp/hcl returns false because TemplateExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression_template.go) records the known start of an unknown template result as a refinement, and Value.Equals (cty/value_ops.go) uses it to rule out "xyz".
